subScenes.name: 挂号登记
subScenes.description: 患者在诊所前台登记信息并领取就诊号。

qaPairs.triggerText: What's the reason for your visit today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您今天来看病是因为什么？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 挂号登记时，前台询问就诊原因

followUps.text: I've had a persistent headache for three days.
followUps.text_cn: 我头痛已经持续三天了。

followUps.text: I'm here for my annual check-up.
followUps.text_cn: 我来做一个年度体检。

followUps.text: I need a prescription refill for my blood pressure medicine.
followUps.text_cn: 我需要续开降压药的处方。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于挂号时说明就诊目的，避免笼统回答如'I feel bad'。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have insurance or need to pay at the front desk?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您有医保吗？还是需要现场缴费？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 挂号时确认支付方式和医保状态

followUps.text: I have public health insurance, here's my card.
followUps.text_cn: 我有医保，这是我的卡。

followUps.text: I don't have insurance—how much do I owe?
followUps.text_cn: 我没有保险，需要付多少钱？

followUps.text: I'm not sure—can you check if my plan covers this visit?
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定，您能帮我查一下我的保险是否覆盖这次就诊吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 回答需明确支付方式，避免沉默或模糊回应导致流程延误。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you confirm your name and date of birth?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 请确认您的姓名和出生日期？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 核对患者身份信息以建立档案

followUps.text: It's Sarah Chen, born on March 15, 1988.
followUps.text_cn: 我叫陈莎拉，出生日期是1988年3月15日。

followUps.text: I think my name is spelled S-A-R-A-H, but I'm not sure about the date.
followUps.text_cn: 我觉得我的名字是S-A-R-A-H，但我不确定出生日期。

followUps.text: I'm here under my husband's insurance—my name is Lisa Wong, but the record might be under James Wong.
followUps.text_cn: 我是用我丈夫的保险来的，我叫王丽莎，但系统里可能是詹姆斯·王。

qaPairs.usageNote: 身份核对环节必须清晰回应，避免因信息错误导致挂号失败或医疗记录混淆。

subScenes.name: 描述症状
subScenes.description: 患者向医生详细说明身体不适的具体表现和持续时间。

qaPairs.triggerText: What seems to be the problem?

followUps.text: I've had a sharp headache for two days, and it's getting worse.
followUps.text_cn: 我两天来一直有剧烈头痛，而且越来越严重。

followUps.text: I'm coughing a lot and feel really tired, but no fever.
followUps.text_cn: 我咳嗽得很厉害，感觉非常疲惫，但没有发烧。

followUps.text: My stomach has been upset since I ate that seafood last night.
followUps.text_cn: 自从昨晚吃了海鲜，我的胃就不舒服了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于向医生清晰描述症状的起始时间、性质和可能诱因，帮助医生快速判断病因。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生进一步定位疼痛部位

followUps.text: It's on the right side of my chest, especially when I breathe in.
followUps.text_cn: 疼在右胸，尤其吸气时更明显。

followUps.text: It's my lower back — it started after I lifted that heavy box.
followUps.text_cn: 是下背部，搬重物后开始的。

followUps.text: Actually, it's not one spot — my whole jaw and neck feel tight.
followUps.text_cn: 其实不是固定一点，整个下巴和脖子都发紧。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回答时应具体说明疼痛位置、是否放射、是否与动作相关，避免只说‘这里疼’。

qaPairs.triggerText: How long have you been feeling this way?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生询问症状持续时间

followUps.text: Just since this morning — it came on suddenly.
followUps.text_cn: 从今天早上开始的，突然发生的。

followUps.text: Off and on for about three weeks — it gets better, then comes back.
followUps.text_cn: 断断续续三周了，时好时坏。

followUps.text: I thought it was just a cold, but it's been three days now and I'm worse.
followUps.text_cn: 我本来以为只是感冒，但已经三天了，反而更严重了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 准确描述症状持续时间有助于医生区分急性病与慢性病，避免模糊回答如‘好几天了’。

subScenes.name: 回答问诊
subScenes.description: 患者回应医生关于病史、饮食和生活习惯的提问。

qaPairs.triggerText: What seems to be the problem?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生初诊时询问主要症状

followUps.text: I've had a sharp headache for two days.
followUps.text_cn: 我两天来一直有剧烈头痛。

followUps.text: I'm not sure, but I feel really tired and have a low fever.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，但我特别累，还有低烧。

followUps.text: It started after I ate seafood last night.
followUps.text_cn: 昨晚吃了海鲜后开始的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于医生初诊时引导患者描述主诉，是问诊中最常见的开场问题。

qaPairs.triggerText: How long have you been feeling this way?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生确认症状持续时间以判断急慢性

followUps.text: Just since yesterday.
followUps.text_cn: 从昨天开始的。

followUps.text: Off and on for a few weeks.
followUps.text_cn: 断断续续好几周了。

followUps.text: I didn't notice until this morning.
followUps.text_cn: 我今天早上才注意到。

qaPairs.usageNote: 医生通过持续时间判断病情性质，患者需简洁明确回应，避免冗长解释。

qaPairs.triggerText: Have you taken any medicine for it?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生评估患者是否自行用药及效果

followUps.text: Yes, I took ibuprofen, but it didn't help.
followUps.text_cn: 吃了布洛芬，但没用。

followUps.text: No, I didn't want to take anything without a doctor's advice.
followUps.text_cn: 没有，我没敢吃药，想先问医生。

followUps.text: I took some herbal tea my mom recommended.
followUps.text_cn: 我喝了妈妈推荐的草药茶。

qaPairs.usageNote: 医生需了解患者用药史以避免药物冲突或误诊，回应应诚实具体。

subScenes.name: 获取医嘱
subScenes.description: 医生给出诊断与治疗建议，患者确认服药与复诊安排。

qaPairs.triggerText: How long have you been feeling this way?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你这种症状持续多久了？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生询问症状持续时间以判断病情发展

followUps.text: About three days. It started after I caught a cold.
followUps.text_cn: 大概三天了，感冒后开始的。

followUps.text: Weeks, actually. I thought it was just a stubborn cough.
followUps.text_cn: 好几个星期了，我以为只是咳得久了一点。

followUps.text: Just this morning. It came on suddenly.
followUps.text_cn: 今天早上才开始的，突然就疼了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于描述症状持续时间，是医生诊断的关键信息，回答应具体、真实。

qaPairs.triggerText: Have you taken any medicine for it?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生确认患者是否自行用药，避免药物冲突

followUps.text: Yes, I took ibuprofen yesterday, but it didn't help much.
followUps.text_cn: 吃了布洛芬，但效果不大。

followUps.text: No, I didn't want to take anything without a doctor's advice.
followUps.text_cn: 没有，我想先听医生建议再吃药。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I might have taken some cold pills, but I can't remember the name.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，可能吃了些感冒药，但记不清名字了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回答需诚实说明用药情况，避免隐瞒或模糊表述，影响诊断。

qaPairs.triggerText: You need to rest, drink plenty of water, and take this medicine three times a day after meals.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你需要多休息、多喝水，饭后每天吃三次这种药。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医生给出明确医嘱，患者需确认理解或表达顾虑

followUps.text: Got it. I'll take it after every meal and call if it gets worse.
followUps.text_cn: 明白了，我会饭后吃药，如果加重就联系你。

followUps.text: Sorry, could you repeat the dosage? I'm a bit nervous about taking it.
followUps.text_cn: 不好意思，能再说一遍剂量吗？我有点担心吃错。

followUps.text: I work nights—can I take it before bed instead?
followUps.text_cn: 我上夜班，能改成睡前吃吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 患者应主动确认医嘱细节，尤其在作息特殊或有疑虑时，避免因误解导致治疗失败。

subScenes.name: 缴费取药
subScenes.description: 患者在药房缴费并领取处方药物，确认使用方法。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay for the prescription?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 缴费取药：支付方式确认

followUps.text: I'll pay by credit card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我刷卡支付，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I don't have a card today.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我今天没带卡。

followUps.text: Can I pay with my health insurance card? I think it covers part of this.
followUps.text_cn: 我能用医保卡支付吗？我觉得这部分费用医保能报销。

qaPairs.usageNote: 在药房缴费时，工作人员常询问支付方式，用户需根据自身情况选择支付手段，包括信用卡、现金或医保。

qaPairs.triggerText: Your medication is ready. Do you need help understanding how to take it?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您的药已经备好了，需要我帮您解释怎么服用吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 缴费取药：确认用药说明

followUps.text: Yes, please. The doctor didn't explain the dosage clearly.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，请帮我解释一下，医生没说清楚剂量。

followUps.text: No, thanks. I already know the instructions.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我知道怎么吃。

followUps.text: Could you write it down? I'm worried I'll forget.
followUps.text_cn: 您能写下来吗？我怕记不住。

qaPairs.usageNote: 取药时药剂师常主动提供用药指导，用户可根据自身理解程度选择接受、拒绝或请求书面说明。

qaPairs.triggerText: The total is $45. Would you like to pick up your next refill now?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 总共是45美元，您现在要预约下一次取药吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 缴费取药：预约下次取药

followUps.text: Yes, I'll take the 30-day refill. When can I pick it up?
followUps.text_cn: 好的，我要30天的续药，什么时候能取？

followUps.text: Not yet—I need to check with my doctor first.
followUps.text_cn: 先不急，我得先问问医生。

followUps.text: Can I schedule it for next month? I'm traveling next week.
followUps.text_cn: 能帮我安排下个月取吗？我下周要出差。

qaPairs.usageNote: 药房常在取药时推荐续药预约，用户可能因计划、经济或医疗原因选择接受、推迟或暂缓。
